name: Gopala
residence: Goshala Quarter (upper outskirts near grazing paths)
personality: strong memory for terrain and routes
daily_routine: leading herd movement to grazing zones
maintaining mountain paths used by livestock
coordinating with Revati for veterinary care
delivering animals for trade or ritual needs
monitoring predator activity near forest edge

goals.public_goal: Maintain healthy herd populations and ensure safe grazing routes while preventing livestock loss in harsh seasons
goals.hidden_goal: Map safer highland routes beyond official grazing boundaries
goals.deep_goal: Understand why certain mountain paths feel 'wrong' or are avoided by animals

beliefs: Animals notice danger before humans do
The land changes slowly, but not always naturally
Old paths are more reliable than new ones
Herd movement is more honest than human conversation
The forest boundary is not as fixed as people believe
